findings.summary: visibilitychange->hidden commits the pending waypoint delete via the unload path (no session refresh, errors swallowed, no cache/save-status update), so a plain tab switch with a stale token silently loses the delete and the waypoint reappears.

Opening the delete-itinerary dialog flushes the pending waypoint delete (irreversible even if the dialog is cancelled) and that DELETE is not sequenced before the itinerary DELETE, so it can 404 and raise a spurious error.
useUpdateMetadata writes nothing to the cache; after save the dialog closes and the old title/cover show until the refetch completes.
enteredFromList flag stays true for the whole editor lifetime, so after in-editor navigation (e.g. to settings) and browser Back, the editor back button uses router.back() and misses the list.
Resolve route buffers and parses the whole JSON body before the 2 KB URL length check; check content-length first.
GOOGLE_HOST regex duplicated in server resolver and domain location-input (drift risk) and its [a-z]{2} branch accepts any two-letter suffix.

flush() can return 'resolving' with no job, which the form reports as LOCATION_REQUIRED; also minor: wrong decision id in permissions.ts comment (D-45 vs D-38) and unused reorderWaypoints use case export.
